title: Mn3O4/biochar catalyst for enhanced PMS activation and antibiotic degradation via radical and non-radical pathways

Mn3O4/biochar composite effectively activates peroxymonosulfate for metronidazole degradation via synergistic radical (SO4˙−/˙OH) and non-radical (1O2) pathways, driven by Mn2+/Mn3+/Mn4+ redox cycling.
